ātmanaḥ svasya caritamajñadaśācaritraṃ svayameva satyaṃ tattvaṃ samanudhāvatā
samyakpaśyatā cittena hasati sati

sabhāgate loke jane valantī parāvṛttā pratyakpravaṇā cittakalā cittavṛttiryasminkarmaṇi
tadyathā syāttathā jñānasya cidekarasānandasya samyagāsvādanatatpare jāte sati
pārthive daśarathe dhyānamivālambya jīvanmuktātmikāṃ sthitimāsvādayati sati

munirvasiṣṭho bhaktānāṃ rājādīnāmarcāṃ pūjāṃ grahītuṃ pūrvoktarītyā kṣaṇaṃ
tūṣṇīmiva sthitvā tadanantaraṃ provāca
parāmarśo viṣayasmaraṇaṃ tadbhoge kautukaṃ tadarthāḥ saṃkalpā iti bhedaḥ

asvapnaṃ mānasaviṣayālocanarahitaṃ apunarbodhaṃ jāgradaindriyakaviṣayālocanarahitaṃ
ca svapimīva

āśābhirvidhuritāṃ vihvalitāṃ prāktanīṃ tanau dehe ātmabuddhyā sthitiṃ pravihasya
sphuradbhirbhavatsūktairupadeśavākyaiḥ sāṃprataṃ svasthastiṣṭhāmi

eteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ tyāgena
ca kāraṇaṃ prayojanaṃ nāsti

maccittāṃ pratyagātmamātrapratiṣṭhitacittāmanapāyinīṃ nityāṃ jīvanmuktasthitiṃ
vyomni svarge sāmrajyasya asurādikṣobhavarjitā yā sthitistāmevānubhavāgīti
lokadṛśltiḥ

ahaṃ bahirdṛśālocanādyaṅgakādaṅgatāṃ gato'pi jagat khādapyatitarāmacchaṃ
cinmātramityeva paśyāmi nājñavajjaḍamityarthaḥ
asmin jagati kṣaye mohanidrayā saha bādhite sati akṣayo'haṃ sadaiva jāgarmi

bhāvikāryaṃ yathākāmaṃ vartamānakāryaṃ yathāprāptaṃ prāgavasthitaṃ kāryaṃ tu
yathāsthitaṃ yadbhavānvakti tadahamapagataiṣaṇaṃ phalābhisaṃdhirahitaṃ
guruśāstrānusāreṇa karomi

kāryamavaśyakartavyaṃ laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ ca kāryaṃ
karomi

samaḥ asya
puṣpasya dehasya vāyamiti viśeṣayitumaśakyatvātsādhāraṇaḥ
tarhi tvamagre kathaṃ ka iva vyavahariṣyasi tatrāha - yathaiveti

ata eva me dehe
viṣayasukhaṃ nehāmi necchāmi

ahaṃ yāvaddehaṃ bālaḥ svavayonurūpāṃ līlāṃ krīḍāmiva yathāprāptāṃ
saṃsārasaṃsthitiṃ pālayāmi

samyagjānātīti saṃjña ātmatattvavitsan raghūṇāṃ
bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyasthāṃ kulasaṃtatiṃ bodhena pāvitavānasi

pitrā saheti jīvatyeva pitari tadājñayā
rākṣasavadhena mahīṃ pālayitvetyāśayaḥ
